flowContents.comments: APHP IMALIVE (hepatocellular carcinoma). Built from the UoA_brain mapping. Columns J, L, N and P carry SNOMED codes (snomed:<code>) until the hyperontology covers them; column I stays on EUCAIM concepts.

labels.label:
Loop 03 for clinical data (APHP IMALIVE dataset):
* Clinical data input normalized and curated is loaded and converted to a relational model.
* Specific mappings are specified during the Data Holder's analysis phase.
Steps:
1. Read normalized and curated csv file and apply structural mapping preparation
2. Apply lookups for coded values
3. Write values transformed to EUCAIM CDM and hyperontology to ingestion database

properties.entity:ImagingProcedureCT:
SELECT 	"ImagingProcedureCT_ProcedureIdentifier" AS ProcedureIdentifier,
		"PrimaryCancerCondition_Identifier" AS PrimaryCancerConditionIdentifier,
		"Patient_Identifier" AS PatientIdentifier,
		CAST("ImagingProcedureCT_Timepoint" AS INTEGER) AS ImagingTimepoint,
		"ImagingProcedureCT_Code" AS ImagingProcedureEUCAIM,
		'CT' AS ImagingProcedureOriginal,
		"ImagingProcedure_Category" AS ImagingProcedureCategoryCodeEUCAIM,
		'Imaging (Procedure)' AS ImagingProcedureCategoryCodeOriginal,
		NULLIF("ImagingProcedureCT_PerformedDate", '') AS PerformedDate,
		1 AS Episode,
		'0' as Processed
FROM FLOWFILE
WHERE COALESCE("ImagingProcedureCT_Timepoint", '') <> ''

properties.entity:PathologyProcedure1:

properties.entity:Patient:
SELECT 	"Patient_Identifier" AS Identifier,
		"Dataset_Identifier" AS DatasetIdentifier,
		"Population" AS	DiagnosticCategoryOriginal,
		"Patient_DiagnosticCategory" AS DiagnosticCategoryEucaim,
		"Sex" AS BirthSexOriginal,
		"Patient_BirthSex" AS BirthSexEucaim,
		"Patient_ManagingOrganization" AS ManagingOrganization,

FROM FLOWFILE
properties.entity:PrimaryCancerCondition:
SELECT 	"PrimaryCancerCondition_Identifier" AS Identifier,
		"Patient_Identifier" AS PatientIdentifier,
		CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM("PrimaryCancerCondition_AgeAtDiagnosis"), '') NOT IN ('', '?')
		     THEN CAST(REPLACE(TRIM("PrimaryCancerCondition_AgeAtDiagnosis"), ',', '.') AS DOUBLE)
		END AS AgeOfDiagnosis,
		'Year' AS AgeUnitOriginal,
		"PrimaryCancerCondition_AgeUnitConcept" AS AgeUnitEUCAIM,
		NULLIF("PrimaryCancerCondition_AssertedDate", '') AS AssertedDate,
		"ICD10 code" AS PrimaryCancerConditionOriginal,
		"PrimaryCancerCondition_Code" AS PrimaryCancerConditionEUCAIM,
		"Pathology" AS HistologyMorphologyBehaviourOriginal,
		"PrimaryCancerCondition_HistologyMorphologyBehaviourCode" AS HistologyMorphologyBehaviourEUCAIM,
		CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM("Pathology procedure confirmation"), '') NOT IN ('', '?')
		     THEN "Procedure1_ProcedureIdentifier"
		END AS ConfirmedByProcedure,
		1 AS EpisodeNumber,
		'0' as Processed
FROM FLOWFILE
properties.entity:SurgicalProcedure1:
SELECT 	"SurgicalProcedure1_Identifier" AS TreatmentIdentifier,
		"Patient_Identifier" AS PatientIdentifier,
		"SurgicalProcedure1_Code" AS ProcedureEUCAIM,
		"Surgery procedure" AS ProcedureOriginal,
		NULLIF("SurgicalProcedure1_PerformedDate", '') AS PerformedDate,
		2 AS Episode,
		'0' as processed
FROM FLOWFILE
WHERE COALESCE(TRIM("Surgery procedure"), '') NOT IN ('', '?')

processors.comments: Every source column is copied to a working field. The *Source fields keep the raw value apart from the field the coded lookup writes back, so the two never collide in the Jolt merge.
processors.name: RenameProperties

processors.comments: Sex 1/0 to Male/Female, dates to yyyy-mm-dd, and the imaging timepoints. Each row holds at most one MRI and one CT; they are numbered 1..N per patient by date (MRI first on a tie or a missing date), which is the number the DICOM timepoints csv has to use.
processors.name: PrepareAuxProperties

properties.aux:
SELECT d.*,
       CASE WHEN TRIM(d."ImagingProcedureMRI_Flag") IN ('1', '1.0')
            THEN CASE WHEN TRIM(d."ImagingProcedureCT_Flag") IN ('1', '1.0') AND d."ImagingProcedureCT_PerformedDate" < d."ImagingProcedureMRI_PerformedDate" THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
       END AS "ImagingProcedureMRI_Timepoint",
       CASE WHEN TRIM(d."ImagingProcedureCT_Flag") IN ('1', '1.0')
            THEN CASE WHEN TRIM(d."ImagingProcedureMRI_Flag") IN ('1', '1.0') AND d."ImagingProcedureCT_PerformedDate" < d."ImagingProcedureMRI_PerformedDate" THEN 1
                      WHEN TRIM(d."ImagingProcedureMRI_Flag") IN ('1', '1.0') THEN 2
                      ELSE 1 END
       END AS "ImagingProcedureCT_Timepoint"
FROM (
    SELECT *,
        CASE WHEN TRIM("Patient_BirthSexSource") IN ('1', '1.0') THEN 'Male'
             WHEN TRIM("Patient_BirthSexSource") IN ('0', '0.0') THEN 'Female'
        END AS "Patient_BirthSex",
        CASE
            WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM("PrimaryCancerCondition_AssertedDateSource")) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("PrimaryCancerCondition_AssertedDateSource") FROM 3 FOR 1) = '/' AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("PrimaryCancerCondition_AssertedDateSource") FROM 6 FOR 1) = '/'
            THEN SUBSTRING(TRIM("PrimaryCancerCondition_AssertedDateSource") FROM 7 FOR 4) || '-' || SUBSTRING(TRIM("PrimaryCancerCondition_AssertedDateSource") FROM 4 FOR 2) || '-' || SUBSTRING(TRIM("PrimaryCancerCondition_AssertedDateSource") FROM 1 FOR 2)
            WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM("PrimaryCancerCondition_AssertedDateSource")) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("PrimaryCancerCondition_AssertedDateSource") FROM 5 FOR 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("PrimaryCancerCondition_AssertedDateSource") FROM 8 FOR 1) = '-'
            THEN SUBSTRING(TRIM("PrimaryCancerCondition_AssertedDateSource") FROM 1 FOR 10)
        END AS "PrimaryCancerCondition_AssertedDate",
        CASE
            WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM("Procedure1_PerformedDateSource")) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("Procedure1_PerformedDateSource") FROM 3 FOR 1) = '/' AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("Procedure1_PerformedDateSource") FROM 6 FOR 1) = '/'
            THEN SUBSTRING(TRIM("Procedure1_PerformedDateSource") FROM 7 FOR 4) || '-' || SUBSTRING(TRIM("Procedure1_PerformedDateSource") FROM 4 FOR 2) || '-' || SUBSTRING(TRIM("Procedure1_PerformedDateSource") FROM 1 FOR 2)
            WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM("Procedure1_PerformedDateSource")) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("Procedure1_PerformedDateSource") FROM 5 FOR 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("Procedure1_PerformedDateSource") FROM 8 FOR 1) = '-'
            THEN SUBSTRING(TRIM("Procedure1_PerformedDateSource") FROM 1 FOR 10)
        END AS "Procedure1_PerformedDate",
        CASE
            WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM("SurgicalProcedure1_PerformedDateSource")) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("SurgicalProcedure1_PerformedDateSource") FROM 3 FOR 1) = '/' AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("SurgicalProcedure1_PerformedDateSource") FROM 6 FOR 1) = '/'
            THEN SUBSTRING(TRIM("SurgicalProcedure1_PerformedDateSource") FROM 7 FOR 4) || '-' || SUBSTRING(TRIM("SurgicalProcedure1_PerformedDateSource") FROM 4 FOR 2) || '-' || SUBSTRING(TRIM("SurgicalProcedure1_PerformedDateSource") FROM 1 FOR 2)
            WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM("SurgicalProcedure1_PerformedDateSource")) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("SurgicalProcedure1_PerformedDateSource") FROM 5 FOR 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("SurgicalProcedure1_PerformedDateSource") FROM 8 FOR 1) = '-'
            THEN SUBSTRING(TRIM("SurgicalProcedure1_PerformedDateSource") FROM 1 FOR 10)
        END AS "SurgicalProcedure1_PerformedDate",
        CASE
            WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM("ImagingProcedureMRI_PerformedDateSource")) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("ImagingProcedureMRI_PerformedDateSource") FROM 3 FOR 1) = '/' AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("ImagingProcedureMRI_PerformedDateSource") FROM 6 FOR 1) = '/'
            THEN SUBSTRING(TRIM("ImagingProcedureMRI_PerformedDateSource") FROM 7 FOR 4) || '-' || SUBSTRING(TRIM("ImagingProcedureMRI_PerformedDateSource") FROM 4 FOR 2) || '-' || SUBSTRING(TRIM("ImagingProcedureMRI_PerformedDateSource") FROM 1 FOR 2)
            WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM("ImagingProcedureMRI_PerformedDateSource")) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("ImagingProcedureMRI_PerformedDateSource") FROM 5 FOR 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("ImagingProcedureMRI_PerformedDateSource") FROM 8 FOR 1) = '-'
            THEN SUBSTRING(TRIM("ImagingProcedureMRI_PerformedDateSource") FROM 1 FOR 10)
        END AS "ImagingProcedureMRI_PerformedDate",
        CASE
            WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM("ImagingProcedureCT_PerformedDateSource")) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("ImagingProcedureCT_PerformedDateSource") FROM 3 FOR 1) = '/' AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("ImagingProcedureCT_PerformedDateSource") FROM 6 FOR 1) = '/'
            THEN SUBSTRING(TRIM("ImagingProcedureCT_PerformedDateSource") FROM 7 FOR 4) || '-' || SUBSTRING(TRIM("ImagingProcedureCT_PerformedDateSource") FROM 4 FOR 2) || '-' || SUBSTRING(TRIM("ImagingProcedureCT_PerformedDateSource") FROM 1 FOR 2)
            WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM("ImagingProcedureCT_PerformedDateSource")) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("ImagingProcedureCT_PerformedDateSource") FROM 5 FOR 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(TRIM("ImagingProcedureCT_PerformedDateSource") FROM 8 FOR 1) = '-'
            THEN SUBSTRING(TRIM("ImagingProcedureCT_PerformedDateSource") FROM 1 FOR 10)
        END AS "ImagingProcedureCT_PerformedDate"
    FROM FLOWFILE
) d
